common.disclaimer: This is a learning exercise. It is not an official driving test and does not replace instruction with a driving instructor.

stop-and-check.title: Stop and check
stop-and-check.goal: Approach the STOP sign, stop before the line, and proceed only when it is safe.
stop-and-check.briefing: Slow down. Stop completely before the line. Check traffic and proceed when the way is clear.

checklist.proceededWhenClear: Proceeded when the way was clear

stop-and-check.retryGuidance: Try again. Stop, check, and proceed only when it is safe.
